pages.text: Thorned vines bound to your arm. $(warn)It has no body to summon$(), so it has none of the shared moves.$(br2)$(bold)Range$(): long$(br)$(bold)Type$(): $(l:stands/types)Specialist$()$(br2)Only two of its own passives work at once. Choose which in its tree.
A $(item)camera$() for Hermit Purple to crush.

Hermit Purple can also wake on its own. A $(l:hamon/learning)Hamon$() user with no Stand who keeps breathing and fighting with Hamon awakens it after spending about $(num)50$() full bars, roughly $(num)ten days$() of steady use.
